svg.title: Index arithmetic IS the tree
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Index arithmetic IS the tree” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing seven values drawn once as a binary tree and once as a flat array of seven boxes with indices zero to six, dotted lines connecting each tree node to its array slot, and the index arithmetic left equals 2i plus 1, right equals 2i plus 2, parent equals i minus 1 over 2 written beside it, with explicit parent and child pointer fields crossed out in red; a level-by-level accounting showing that half the nodes are leaves needing zero swaps while only the root needs log n, summing to linear work; a sift-down swapping down past the smaller child; and measured bars of 22.7 milliseconds for bottom-up heapify against 42.0 milliseconds for a million successive pushes.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
